2) Vendor form: Please complete the vendor-update form so we can capture the new remit address and the primary AP contact. Link: https://redwood.shared/vendor-update-form (one-page).

3) Tax & legal: Laura (cc'd) — can you confirm whether the new remit address or the entity split triggers any additional legal review?

4) PO impact: We have PO-23456 scheduled for payment around 2026-10-12. AP will temporarily hold that payment until bank verification is complete (max 10 business days). If you can provide the bank letter by end of this week we should be fine.

Action items: Elena — send bank letter or voided check + return vendor-update form by 2026-09-18.
